user.title: ACiQ / Midea TL04-1 thermostat
user.description:
Enter the thermostat's IP address. Home Assistant connects over ADB (port 5555, no password on this device) and runs read-only checks before changing anything.

{checks}

data_description.host: The thermostat's IP address (shown in your router; hostname starts with midea_). Give it a DHCP reservation.
data_description.name: Name for the device in Home Assistant, e.g. Family Room.
data_description.port: Port the local API daemon will listen on (default 8080).
data_description.adb_port: Android Debug Bridge port on the thermostat (default 5555).

confirm.title: Pre-flight checks passed

reconfigure.title: Reconfigure thermostat connection
reconfigure.description:
Change the thermostat's IP or ports. Pre-flight checks run again and must find the same thermostat (serial number).

{checks}

data_description.host: The thermostat's IP address on your network (give it a DHCP reservation).
data_description.port: Port of the local API daemon on the thermostat.
data_description.adb_port: Android Debug Bridge port on the thermostat (5555).

error.cannot_connect: Could not reach the thermostat over ADB: {checks}
error.checks_failed:
Pre-flight checks failed — this firmware or setup has not been verified:

{checks}
error.no_serial: The thermostat did not report a serial number.

abort.cannot_connect: Could not reach the thermostat over ADB
abort.not_supported: This device is not a supported/verified TL04-1 thermostat
abort.wrong_device: That address belongs to a different thermostat (serial number mismatch)

data.extra_allowed_ips: Extra IPs allowed to use the thermostat API (comma separated)
data.block_egress: Block the thermostat's cloud traffic at the source

data_description.auto_deploy: Copy and start the local API daemon on the thermostat at startup and after it reboots. Turn off only if you manage the daemon yourself.
data_description.extra_allowed_ips: Home Assistant's own IP is always allowed. Add other machines (e.g. a workstation) that may use the thermostat API directly.
data_description.block_egress: Drops traffic from the thermostat to public internet addresses only. Local traffic is never blocked (your LAN, any private 10/172.16/192.168 network, link-local, VPN/Tailscale 100.64/10, Home Assistant, broadcast/multicast). Temporary rule on the thermostat: re-applied after reboots, removed when turned off, cleared by a power cycle. Stops the ACiQ cloud client's endless DNS retries; the ACiQ app will not work while on.

error.invalid_ip: One of the IPs is not valid

firmware_unverified.title: Thermostat firmware changed — local control disabled
firmware_unverified.description: The thermostat reports firmware {firmware}, but control was verified only on {verified}. Readings still work; control commands are blocked until the integration is updated for this firmware.

deploy_failed.title: Could not start the thermostat API daemon
deploy_failed.description: Deploying over ADB failed: {error}. Check that the thermostat is online and that ADB (TCP 5555) is reachable from Home Assistant.

redeploy_failed.message: The thermostat API is unreachable and redeploying the daemon failed: {error}

no_state_yet.message: The daemon has not seen the thermostat's state yet

fan_locked.message: Fan speed can only be changed in Heat or Cool mode (current mode: {mode})

deploy_failed.message: Could not deploy the daemon to the thermostat: {error}

egress_failed.message: Could not change the cloud-traffic block on the thermostat: {error}. Nothing was changed; it will be re-checked automatically.
